scientific_question: How are motoneuron pools anatomically organized across joints in the lumbosacral enlargement?
mechanism: Fusiform motoneuron columns across 30 slices / 100 levels
main_result: Rostral hip flexors/knee extensors vs caudal hip extensors/knee flexors; unit oscillators separated by 55-62 levels
quantitative_metric: Hip sep: 61.8 lvl, Knee sep: 55.8 lvl, Ankle sep: 25.5 lvl

scientific_question: What is the numerical rostrocaudal distribution and flexor/extensor balance of spinal motoneurons?
main_result: Severe extensor/caudal bias: 77% extensors caudal (L7-S1), 81% flexors rostral (L4-L6); 4,034 total MNs
quantitative_metric: Total: 4034 MNs; Extensor Caudal: 1817 (77%), Flexor Rostral: 620 (81%)

scientific_question: What are the standardized EMG activation profiles of 27 hindlimb muscles in the step cycle?
main_result: Extensors active in stance & late swing (E1); Flexors active in swing; Retractors burst at stance-to-swing transition

scientific_question: What is the spatiotemporal activity landscape of motoneurons over consecutive locomotor step cycles?
mechanism: Matrix product A(s, t) = sum N_m,s * (EMG_m(t)/100)
main_result: Caudal stance peak (~204 MNs/slice) dominates; small rostral swing peak (~60-80 MNs); rapid migration
quantitative_metric: Grid size: 30 slices x 200 time bins, Peak: 204 MNs

scientific_question: How sensitive is spatiotemporal activity migration and center of mass trajectory to recruitment assumptions?
mechanism: Center of mass r_cm(t) and migration velocity
main_result: Displacement spans 39.5 levels (11.3 mm, ~53% of range); peak velocities reach 217-438 mm/s; caudal detour confirmed
